# Repo for Forking Paths, Open Doors: *Designing Transparent and Reproducible Quantitative Studies in Applied Linguistics*



## Download bib files

Render this file to download the latest version of the bib files from `many-forks/bibliography`:

```{r}
#| label: get-refs

# Set bib file url
file_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/many-forks/bibliography/master/"
bib_name <- glue::glue("ch{1:6}.bib") |> as.vector()
links <- glue::glue("{file_url}{bib_name}") |> as.vector()

for (i in 1:length(links)) {
  print(links[i])
  print(bib_name[i])
  download.file(
  links[i], 
  cacheOK = F, 
  destfile = paste0("./refs/", bib_name[i]),
  method = "curl"
  )
}

```
